sloka: ताभिराश्वासिता सीता रावणं राक्षसाधिपम् ।उवाचात्महितं वाक्यं वृत्तशौण्डीर्यगर्वितम् ।। ५.२०.१२।।।।
transliteration: tābhirāśvāsitā sītā rāvaṇaṁ rākṣasādhipam ।uvācātmahitaṁ vākyaṁ vṛttaśauṇḍīryagarvitam ।। 5.20.12।।।।

translations.english: "Your charming youth should not pass away (uselessly). A past event does not come back like a current of stream.
